candidate: H69 initialization-conditioned paired-neuron implicit MLP manifold
causal_question: Can one globally shared nonlinear decoder use exact reproducible complete-neuron initialization pairs as keys to express the high-entropy ambient bases of three measured low-temporal-rank MLP paths under one percent persistent FP16 state?
forbidden: CE training or evaluation as a promotion criterion
stored trajectory PCs, empirical basis vectors, dense shadows, or per-neuron learned embeddings
width, latent, activation, optimizer, seed, layer, or horizon sweeps

inputs.residual_gauge: for each layer concatenate c_fc rows and transposed c_proj rows into 3072 paired complete-neuron rows, subtract exact step-zero W0, and form uncentered displacement PCs

equations.key: s_lj = P_u u0_lj + P_v v0_lj + e_l

fit.objective: sum over layers and top-16 paired PCs of eigenvalue-weighted squared reconstruction error, normalized independently by each layer's retained top-16 energy
fit.offline_pc_codes: one fitted 16-vector per layer/PC is a nuisance coordinate used only to measure decoder image capacity and is not charged as deployed state

controls.equal_state_linear: replace GELU difference by its linear cancellation C z; retain identical charged tensors
controls.w0_blind: replace exact u0/v0 keys by deterministic seed-bound Gaussian pseudo-initialization of the same shapes; retain the identical nonlinear decoder and state
controls.fixed_random_decoder: freeze the seed-bound candidate decoder and optimize only nuisance PC codes
controls.unpaired: fit detector and write sides with separate nonlinear masks/codes as an optimistic diagnostic of the cost of complete-neuron coupling

metrics: candidate minus equal-state-linear and W0-blind margins
state bytes, refresh FLOPs, runtime, peak CUDA memory, source/input/output hashes
promotion: Only a complete representation pass authorizes chronological late-state and disjoint-stream A/B audits with the decoder frozen and fresh latent codes fitted. It does not authorize CE or scale-up.
rejection: Any required gate failure closes this exact initialization-conditioned paired-neuron decoder without a sweep and requires new theory before another transform.
